description: Automation-ready template metadata for selecting PPTX slide templates from extracted PDF content.

selection_logic.rule: Select templates by category, use_when, content type, text limits, and image requirements. Do not exceed max character limits.
selection_logic.image_generation: Use Nano Banana for Slide 18 and any template with image areas when a project-specific visual is needed.
